summary: A fleet root can declare its accountable trace person, authored only by that person

replay.detail: Local publication, raw intent.desired writes and replicated admission validate the same-person root rule and matching canonical child. No history rewrite.

schema.detail: Adds optional accountable person reference to intent.desired and declaration reads, canonical agent KDL child, registry digest and generated clients. No database layout change or new claim kind.

compatibility.detail: All-member upgrade before publishing accountable roots. Older members retain the closed-schema field as unknown, without enforcing it or selecting the declaration. Existing declarations have no field. Only the named person may author a top-level accountable root; delegated declarations are not supported and require a separate decision. Trace attribution only: ask routing, own-ask authority and directive-note ownership are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no storage migration.

manual.detail: Upgrade every member, then have the accountable person publish the root. No inferred principal or automatic backfill.

recovery.detail: Remove accountable declarations on upgraded members before binary rollback; otherwise older members retain them as unknown.
